Hi Mina,

We're kicking off GreyCourt's renewal procurement window and need to confirm audit coverage for Redwood's SOC 2 attestation. Our renewal review is scheduled for the committee on Aug 16; procurement requires any outstanding compliance items uploaded by Aug 12 to allow time for legal review.

Specifically could you confirm: 1) Latest SOC 2 Type II report and the audit period covered (start/end dates), 2) Whether you can provide an interim bridge letter covering the period between your report end date and our Aug 16 renewal date, and 3) Any portal or secure upload link we should use for procurement.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
